sub_mechanism: Graphviz node creation order in a state SVEK scope that has live clusters (Basin/Lock family: history_depth2_crossing, AW rh_deep_depth3; review-3 obligation 4)
status: maker causal account before draft; independent review required
java_locations: svek/DotStringFactory.java#createDotString (lines 184-192): root.printCluster1 (inverted-link start nodes), lines0, root.printCluster2, lines1.

svek/Cluster.java#printCluster2 (538-575): the cluster's own NORMAL nodes (getNodesOrderedWithoutTop, Bibliotekon creation order) are appended first, then each child cluster's printInternal; ClusterDotString.printInternal (74-180) emits the child's ranked border points and its own nodes before its subclusters.

Graphviz's DOT reader creates nodes in textual order, and dot's initial mincross order follows node creation: the root's own node (Probe/Pump) is created before every node of the Ring1/Basin subgraph, so it is placed left of the cluster in both Java references.
rust_locations: crates/rustuml-layout/src/graph.rs#graphviz_node_creation_order: with plantuml_svek_node_order and SVEK clusters, the unclustered nodes come first and clusters are then visited in preorder (exactly printCluster2); without the flag, clusters are visited first and the unclustered nodes are appended at the end.

crates/rustuml-render/src/state.rs#layout_autonomous_scope: builds its LayoutGraph without with_plantuml_svek_node_order, unlike render_non_autarkic_root_clusters (and the class, component, deployment, usecase and archimate SVEK paths).
causal_divergence: A state scope with live clusters (the outer scope of build_autonomous_composite, or an image region) creates its own nodes after the cluster nodes, the reverse of Java's DOT text, so Graphviz mirrors the layout: Probe right of Ring1 (rh_deep_depth3), Pump right of Basin (history_depth2_crossing).
invariant: Every state SVEK scope creates its Graphviz nodes in Java's DOT text order: inverted-link starts and line0 nodes, then the scope's own nodes, then each live cluster's nodes in preorder.
planned_change: layout_autonomous_scope builds its LayoutGraph with with_plantuml_svek_node_order(). The flag only changes graphviz_node_creation_order when SVEK clusters exist, so scopes without live clusters keep their DOT input.
declared_residue: The order of a cluster's own nodes is Rust's layout id order; Java's is Bibliotekon creation order. The two agree on the relayed cases; probes with leaves created in a different order are relayed.
